snippet.title: Bathysphere - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Bathysphere is a deep-sea horror strategy game combining a Battleship-inspired 5×5 board game with knowledge-based exploration. Descend into the depths, survive mysterious encounters, and use what you learn across repeated expeditions to uncover the truth behind your sister’s disappearance. Bathysphere will be available on PC and Mac.
